en.title: X-Men '97 Season 2 Post-Credits Scene Hints at Major Villain Return
en.summary: The animated series' latest cliffhanger teases a familiar face's comeback, setting the stage for even greater mutant conflict in the future. A subtle visual cue in the Season 2 finale points to a significant antagonist's impending return.
en.body:
The electrifying conclusion to **X-Men '97** Season 2 didn't just leave us reeling from **Graydon Creed's** ascent to the U.S. presidency; it also planted a seed for future threats with a blink-and-you'll-miss-it post-credits scene. As **Val Cooper** of X-Factor watches the disturbing political developments unfold, she receives an unexpected visitor. This visitor, who bears a striking resemblance to **Cooper** herself, is more than just a doppelganger – she's a harbinger of returning danger.

The scene cleverly employs a visual callback, hinting strongly at the reappearance of **Mystique**, the shapeshifting mutant who played a pivotal role in the original **X-Men: The Animated Series**. Her ability to perfectly mimic others makes her a formidable and unpredictable foe, and her potential return alongside **Creed** spells significant trouble for the X-Men. This isn't the first time the show has expertly woven in deep-cut references; earlier episodes have featured nods to storylines like "One Man's Worth," demonstrating the creative team's commitment to honoring the franchise's rich history.

## A Familiar Face Returns

The implications of **Mystique's** potential return are vast. Her complex history with the X-Men, and particularly with characters like **Nightcrawler** (who she initially tried to kill before a change of heart), offers fertile ground for compelling character arcs and intense confrontations. The scene's subtle yet effective use of a doppelganger to foreshadow her arrival is a testament to the show's sophisticated storytelling. It’s a moment that rewards dedicated viewers, offering an Easter egg that’s far more than just a nostalgic nod—it’s a direct setup for future conflict and a promise of more intricate plots to come.

## What This Means for Season 3

Fans are buzzing about the possibilities this post-credits scene unlocks for **X-Men '97** Season 3. The combination of **Graydon Creed's** political power and **Mystique's** covert abilities presents a dual threat that the X-Men will struggle to counter. This teases a potential team-up of villains, perhaps drawing inspiration from comic storylines involving groups like the Acolytes, who have also been hinted at. The show has consistently delivered on its promise to explore the darker, more complex aspects of the X-Men universe, and this cliffhanger suggests the stakes will only be higher in the next installment. The anticipation for how these narrative threads will unravel is palpable within the fan community.

## What's Next

While specific details for **X-Men '97** Season 3 have not yet been announced, this post-credits scene clearly signals that the returning characters and escalating threats will be central to the upcoming season. Viewers should expect a deeper dive into the political machinations of **Graydon Creed** and the cunning manipulations of **Mystique** as the X-Men face their most challenging era yet.

content_raw: News X-Men 97 X-Men ’97 Season 2 Post-Credits Scene Uses a Cute Easter Egg To Set Up a Returning Character A callback to an X-Men character’s history teases their future By Matthew Byrd | Published on August 12, 2026 Photo Credit: Disney+ Comment 0 Share New Share X-Men ’97 Season 2 Post-Credits Scene Uses a Cute Easter Egg To Set Up a Returning Character&url= target=”_blank” title=”Twitter”> X-Men ’97 Season 2 Post-Credits Scene Uses a Cute Easter Egg To Set Up a Returning Character” target=”_blank” title=”Pinterest”> Photo Credit: Disney+ This article includes spoilers for X-Men ’97 Season 2 It feels odd highlighting an Easter egg in a show like X-Men ‘97 . It’s a shining tribute to all things X-Men that is never afraid to make the deepest pulls a major aspect of its many, many storylines. But the post-credits scene for X-Men ‘97 season 2 not only includes a particularly cute Easter egg but also a reference that effectively helps set up one of the show’s next antagonists. Season 2 of X-Men ‘97 ends with (among other things) Graydon Creed being elected President of the United States. Though the son of two mutants (Sabretooth and Mystique), Creed’s belief that he was abandoned by his parents fostered his hatred towards mutants which he then turned into a successful political platform. His vendetta against mutants will undoubtedly make him one of the major villains of the show’s third season. In its final moments, though, the show hints at an even more intriguing antagonist. As X-Factor’s Val Cooper is watching Creed on TV, she receives an unexpected visitor: a woman who certainly looks a lot like Val Cooper. The Val Cooper at her desk shockingly shoots her recently arrived doppelganger before revealing that she is, in fact, Mystique. Soon thereafter, Mystique flips through her own files which note that she is determined to attack the United States. Mystique seemingly agrees with this assessment, which effectively sets up a potentially complicated series of antagonistic agendas that will play out in the next season. Hey, it wouldn’t be X-Men ‘97 without as many intertwined plotlines as possible , would it? The fun part of this scene is hidden in Mystique’s files, which list Randall C., Jennifer D., Jennifer L., and Rebecca R. among her previous aliases. If those names sound familiar, it’s because they are references to the actresses Randall Carpenter, Jennifer Dale, Rebecca Romijn, and Jennifer Lawrence who all previously played Mystique in other X-Men adaptations. Randall Carpenter (who originally voiced Mystique in X-Men: The Animated Series ) seemingly returns to play the character in this scene and will likely continue to do so in season 3.[end-mark] The post X-Men ’97 Season 2 Post-Credits Scene Uses a Cute Easter Egg To Set Up a Returning Character appeared first on Reactor .
